title: Homo Animalus
subtitle: On the Animal We Never Stopped Being
author: Andries J. Greyling
logline: A dairy farmer's son follows the thread from a shark diver's hands to his own dogs, cats, and chickens, through the science of Radin, the Sheldrakes, and Dispenza, to the animals in the smoke of the oldest human visions — and arrives, unmistakably, at the animal he never stopped being.
